Jordan: Quick async check — cut window in ~2h. Drop a 1-line done / blocker / what you're doing for the next 2h.
Liam: Done: cherry-pick #482 applied to canary, unit tests green locally. Blocker: none. Plan: run canary smoke and sanity checks, ~20m.
Pat: Done: merged autoscaler infra config. Blocker: CI e2e 'kv-cache-smoke' is flaky — timeout in runner-07 ~30% of runs. Logs show docker network reset. Pinged @eng-infra. Plan: need triage or a temporary retry wrapper.
Sara: Done: observed canary traffic ramp; slight error spike after warmup in us-west. Blocker: saw one model fallback (OOM on g4dn when seq len spiked). Plan: rolling back quantized model variant on canary, will also lower batch size.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started canary deploy build/rel-2026.2 -> us-west (3 nodes) — rollout id: r-17495-usw.
release-conductor: If OOMs are the issue, prefer patching runtime to batch_size=1 + kv-cache retention down before full rollback. That might let us validate other fixes without losing coverage.
Liam: On it — prepping runtime patch: set `batch_size=1`, `kv_cache_retention=0.25`. Pushing PR now: https://git.internal/r/rel/PR-327 (will link after).
Pat: If anyone can spare cycles, can someone reboot runner-07 and add a retry wrapper to the flaky test? A quick `systemctl restart runner-07` + re-run proves whether it's infra or test harness. @eng-infra
Jordan: Thanks. Plan: collect go/no-go at T-30m. If canary is stable for 15m after Liam's patch, we proceed with the cut. Drop +1 here if you can watch the canary for the next 30m. :thumbsup:
Sara: +1 watching canary metrics and logs, will post if error rate >1% or OOM recurs.
Liam: +1 will monitor deployment and re-run smoke commands: `kubectl rollout status deploy/canary-us-west -w`
Pat: +1 on runner triage, will follow up in #eng-infra.
Jordan: Appreciate it — I'll gather final confirmations at T-30 and call the train. Keep pings short here.
